assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one tiny Peris fantasy strategy game navigation icon, transparent square PNG. Primary request: one original solid gold CROWN for the Rankings button, matching the illustrated low-poly object icons in the three reference images. References are style only: the same faceted geometry, softly painted natural materials, restrained ivory, warm gold and slate-blue palette, upper-left soft studio lighting, three-quarter slightly elevated isometric view. Subject: a compact, thick, open royal crown with a broad gold band and five simple tapered points, a small slate-blue central inset gem, warm gold highlights and softly shaded bronze inner surfaces. Strong simple chunky silhouette readable at 24px. Match the icon density and tangible miniature-object treatment of the reference citadel, scroll and armillary book. Composition: one complete crown centered, occupying 80% of the square; genuinely transparent empty background. No character, cushion, pedestal, surrounding objects, text, letters, numbers, logo, frame, tile, outline glyph, heavy black contour, scenery or external cast shadow. One icon only; no contact sheet. This must look like a little dimensional painted gold object, not a thin line crown.
